| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Levels** `levels` | 4 | 1 to 8 levels | How many times the image is reduced. Each level halves the width and the height. The pyramid stops early when a level is one pixel. |
| **Gain, level 1** `gain1` | 1 | 0 to 4 | The gain a_0 on L_0, the finest detail level. |
| **Gain, level 2** `gain2` | 1 | 0 to 4 | The gain a_1 on L_1, detail about twice as large as in level 1. |
| **Gain, level 3** `gain3` | 1 | 0 to 4 | The gain a_2 on L_2, detail about four times as large as in level 1. |
| **Gain, level 4** `gain4` | 1 | 0 to 4 | The gain a_3 on L_3, detail about eight times as large as in level 1. Levels above 4 keep gain 1. |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect 101 (default) | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | RGB | RGB, Brightness only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
